name: Cannonball
description:
Cannonball is an enhanced, open-source C++ engine rewrite of Yu Suzuki's classic 1986 arcade driving game OutRun. It loads the original arcade ROM data to deliver a faithful recreation with extensive modern enhancements.

Features:
- Smooth 60 frames per second gameplay doubling the original arcade framerate
- True widescreen 16:9 rendering with seamless scenery expansion
- Force feedback support for modern racing wheels and vibration gamepads
- Custom track layouts, time trial modes, and multiple difficulty levels
- High-quality stereo music and sound effect playback
